description: Edge case: ambiguous supplier — 'Acme Bearing' matches both SUP-001 and SUP-006
notes: 'Acme Bearing' (no GmbH/Group suffix) should score nearly equally against SUP-001 'Acme Bearings GmbH' and SUP-006 'ACME Bearing Group Ltd' — Fuse gap < 0.15 → ambiguous=true → ambiguous_supplier → human queue. EUR 625 × 0.96 = CHF 600.
